occurrences.label: Another key, different rhythm
occurrences.note: Your notes 1 to 8 (of 8) have the same intervals here, in another key: your D becomes G, which is 5 semitones up or 7 down. The rhythm differs. In eighth notes, the score plays them as 8 8 8 8 4 2/3; yours are 2 3 1 1 1 6.

libretto.text: Bezeug’ es dies Schwert, das zaglos ich halte:
libretto.translation: Let this sword bear witness, which I hold without fear:

libretto.text: Wälse verhieß mir, in höchster Not
libretto.translation: Wälse promised me, in direst need,

libretto.text: Dort schützt dich Nothung, das Schwert,
libretto.translation: There Nothung, the sword, will protect you,
when Siegmund has succumbed to you in love.

occurrences.label: Another key, different rhythm
occurrences.note: Your notes 1 to 8 (of 8) have the same intervals here, in another key: your D becomes G, which is 5 semitones up or 7 down. The rhythm differs. In eighth notes, the score plays them as 9 9 6 6 6 1; yours are 2 3 1 1 1 6.

libretto.text: Dir Treuen dank’ ich heiligen Trost!
libretto.translation: To you, faithful one, I owe holy comfort!

libretto.text: Für ihn, den wir liebten, rett’ ich das Liebste:
libretto.translation: For him whom we loved I save what is dearest:

libretto.text: meines Dankes Lohn lache dir einst!
libretto.translation: may the reward of my thanks smile on you one day!
